title: A Birthday Invitation
text:
Maria is having a birthday party on Saturday. She invites her friend Tom to the party at her house. The party starts at four o'clock. Tom says yes, and he is very happy.

Maria asks Tom to bring a cake. Tom says he can bring a cake, but he cannot stay late. They both laugh and say goodbye. Maria is excited about the party.

questions.text: What does Maria ask Tom to bring?
How does Maria feel about the party?
What can we guess about Tom?

vocabulary.definition: asks someone to come to an event
an event where people meet to have fun
feeling happy and eager about something

paragraph_translations: María tiene una fiesta de cumpleaños el sábado. Invita a su amigo Tom a la fiesta en su casa. La fiesta empieza a las cuatro en punto. Tom dice que sí y está muy contento.
María le pide a Tom que lleve un pastel. Tom dice que puede llevar un pastel, pero no puede quedarse hasta tarde. Los dos se ríen y se despiden. María está emocionada por la fiesta.
